recommended_approach: Mantaflow Liquid (FLIP) Domain + continuous LIQUID Inflow Flow object + Collision Effector wine-glass container + Liquid Mesh export, with optional Liquid Particles for extra splash droplets.

key_parameters.Surface Emission: low / resolution-dependent; tune only as needed
key_parameters.Surface Thickness: increase on the glass effector if thin-wall leakage appears

warnings: Flow objects must be contained within the Domain bounding box to affect the simulation.
The Domain must have a material assigned for rendering.
Surface Emission is dependent on domain resolution, so changing resolution requires retuning emission behavior.
Thin wine-glass walls may need extra Surface Thickness on the effector to avoid leaks.
Planar or non-manifold emitter/collider geometry should be marked appropriately (Is Planar / use_plane_init) for more accurate results.
Liquid particle export adds detail for splash droplets but also increases bake complexity/time.
No API doc_refs were surfaced by doc search beyond bpy.types.FluidDomainSettings, so flow/effector operator references may need manual verification in-script.
alternative_approaches: Mantaflow Liquid + Liquid Particles (Spray/Foam/Bubbles) when the base liquid mesh does not produce enough airborne droplets at impact.
Mantaflow Liquid + Guides to steer or stabilize the incoming pour while preserving physically plausible motion.
Base Mantaflow liquid sim for the fill/surface, with a separate secondary pass for over-rim drips if the main sim does not reliably produce elegant exterior trails.
